summary: The proposed patch addresses the alias conflict issue during QuerySet combination. It introduces a mechanism to bump the alias prefix of the right-hand side query to prevent conflicts.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new method `bump_prefix` with an additional parameter `exclude`, which deviates slightly from the original method signature. This could be considered a minor style inconsistency.

The assertion in `change_aliases` is now commented, but there is no corresponding documentation update explaining the purpose of this assertion. Adding a comment or updating the documentation would improve clarity.
